scope: Offline cached development only; no network or inference calls
limitations: Selection was already used for earlier model selection and is not fresh validation.
Tune OOF scores select both hyperparameters and threshold; this is not nested CV.
No leaderboard or held-out test superiority is established by this development assessment.
Bootstrap intervals condition on this fitted model and do not include model-search uncertainty.

candidate_selection_rule.rule: within one fold standard error of best pooled OOF score, then lowest C, then highest OOF score
candidate_selection_rule.limitation: Fold SE is descriptive: folds share training data and threshold is fit on pooled OOF predictions.

procedure.one_se_confirmation_timing: The one-SE preference was requested after the initial assessment. It was checked using tune data only and retained the exact original chosen model and threshold; the original serialized model is unchanged and selection was not reassessed.
